paper.title_en: Emergence and Detection of Surface altermagnetism in KV$_2$Se$_2$O
paper.abstract_en: We demonstrate the recent concept of emergent surface altermagnetism through its unique signatures in KV$_2$Se$_2$O. We show that for bulk antiferromagnetically ordered KV$_2$Se$_2$O, the (001) surface exhibits $d$-wave altermagnetism. Our results fully explain the recent seemingly contradicgting experimental evidence, independently showing both an antiferromagnetically ordered bulk from neutron diffraction, and $d$-wave spin splitting from photoemission spectroscopy. To fully verify this conecept, we predict, as a key experimental signature, a large nonlinear Edelstein response, which is localized at the surface, and follows the $d$-wave altermagnetic symmetry. These results are not only relevant for the metallic and room-temperature magnet KV$_2$Se$_2$O, but also for several other Lieb lattice systems. Our work expands the pool of techniques that can be used to detect altermagnetism emerging at the surfaces of antiferromagnets.
